duration.text: The E-Commerce at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: The application documents in other languages must be notarized in English or Chinese. 1. application form. 2. Passport homepage. 3. Senior high school diploma or expected graduation certificate. 4. High school transcript. 5. Language proficiency certificates. Note: Applicants who apply for Chinese Language and Literature do not need to provide language qualification certificates. 6. Recent Physical Examination Record for Foreigner. 7. Non-criminal record report (usually issued within six months before the application submission date). 8. Curriculum Vitae. 9. Remittance voucher of application fee (CNY400/CNY600 ). 10. Certificate of deposit (at least CNY20,000 or equivalent foreign currency). 11. Proof of outstanding academic achievements, sports, art, cultural exchanges, public welfare activities, etc. (not mandatory).

requirements.text: I. Eligibility 1. Applicants must be citizens of a country other than the People's Republic of China. 2. Applicants must be high school diploma holders and under the age of 30. 3. Applicants are in good health both mentally and physically. 4. Applicants must meet minimum language proficiency standards. Chinese-taught programs: HSK level 4≥210 scores (valid for two years). There are no Chinese language proficiency requirements for the applicants of English-taught programs. English-taught programs: TOEFL≥78 scores, IELTS≥6.0 scores, or equivalent English language proficiency certificates.
